summary.text: Lincoln Fillmore is a Republican member of the Utah State Senate for District 17 in Salt Lake County, appointed on January 5, 2016. He chairs the Senate Rules Committee and is listed as a small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Fillmore earned a B.S. in mass communication from the University of Utah, according to the Utah Legislature's roster.
